release.minimumWork: All listed objects retain fixed exterior+interior tasks; inspect available work throughout section, implement supported differences and preserve unresolved subitems. Three micro-edits do not close the section.
release.acceptanceGate: Every required facet/child/expansion resolved and ACCEPTED or justified NOT_APPLICABLE; no VERIFY_PENDING/PARTIAL/BLOCKED_* treated as accepted; actual browser before/after evidence at final commit/content hash.
release.partialPublicationLabel: If code is safely published before whole-zone acceptance, name it R61-D incremental candidate with explicit remaining list; never say entire zone verified.
release.nextSectionPolicy: After section-wide executable pass/integration, continue next section when local blocked items remain; retain prior section as incomplete and rescan all unfinished items, never delete blocked work.
